name: Quant_Efficiency_Lab
description: Quant Efficiency Lab is an open-source quantitative analysis engine built with Python and Streamlit. It is designed to evaluate the true efficiency of mutual funds and ETFs, cutting through marketing narratives to reveal whether an active manager is truly generating alpha or simply charging high fees for a closet-indexed portfolio.

features: 🤖 Returns-Based Style Analysis (RBSA): The engine mathematically deconstructs a fund's historical returns against standard proxies (Global Equity, Bonds, Cash) to build a highly correlated "Shadow ETF". This reveals…
👨‍💼 Investor Dashboard (Intuitive): Translates complex econometrics into tangible retail metrics:
Active Fee Proxy: Calculates the real cost you are paying for the active portion of the portfolio.
The Airbag Test: Measures Downside Capture during actual market crashes.
